const f:(s:string)=>string|null=(s:string)=>{if(!s)return null;const d=new Map,k=/^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/;for(const r of s.split(',')){const at=r.indexOf('='),left=r.slice(0,at),v=r.slice(at+1),q=left.split(':'),id=q.join('�');if(at<0||q.length!==2||!k.test(q[0])||!k.test(q[1])||!v||[...v].some(c=>c.charCodeAt(0)<32||c.charCodeAt(0)>126||c===',')||d.has(id))return null;d.set(id,[q[0],q[1],v])}return[...d.values()].sort((a,b)=>a[0]<b[0]?-1:a[0]>b[0]?1:a[1]<b[1]?-1:a[1]>b[1]?1:0).map(x=>x[0]+'.'+x[1]+'='+x[2]).join(',')};
